messages:
Elena (CEO): Quick post-all-hands follow-up 926: thanks for the great questions. Dropping a short list of clarifications + owners so nothing slips.
Devon (VP Product): Short clarifications from the roadmap Qs we didn't get to: 1) "Private onboarding" will start with a guided checklist + automation on day 1; 2) "Audit log exports" will support S3 exports in v1.
Lin (Customer Ops): I'll own the private onboarding checklist (owner: @Lin). Plan: draft by Fri 04/02, pilot with two early customers.
Tao (Finance): Pricing note from finance: we won't change hosted tiers this quarter; we're modeling Dedicated committed options and will share numbers for sales enablement by 04/09.
Marcus (Eng Manager): On Dedicated perf targets: P99 targets are still TBD for burst workloads. We'll instrument end-to-end traces and post a baseline next week.
Priya (SRE): Ops calendar: adding a Dedicated failover drill on 04/12-04/13; please tag routes or customers that must be included.
Devon (VP Product): Regarding the eval alerts question 12: plan is opt-in customer alerts + a web hook for signal delivery. Security review required.
Elena (CEO): Two asks for the group: 1) If you raised a question in the AMA and didn't get an answer, please repost here or DM leadership; 2) react with :eyes: once you've read this thread.
deploy-bot: "deploy" posted: canary rollout started for web-console v0.9. Smoke tests queued.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Note: the canary showed a small perf regression on metric "route_init_time". Investigating now.
Lin (Customer Ops): I captured the top customer priorities from the Q&A: audit exports, private onboarding, rollout controls, longer logs retention, cost insights. I'll add to the onboarding doc.
Tao (Finance): Action for product teams: if you want a Dedicated pricing scenario modeled, drop an ask in #finance-requests with expected usage profile.
Devon (VP Product): Action list (owners + dates):\n``\n- @Lin -> draft private onboarding checklist (04/02)\n- @Marcus -> baseline perf traces for Dedicated (04/06)\n- @Priya -> run Dedicated failover drill (04/12-04/13)\n- @Tao -> publish sample Dedicated pricing scenarios (04/09)\n- @Devon -> post roadmap timeline update (04/01)\n```\nPlease ack with :white_check_mark: if you own the item.
Elena (CEO): We'll do a short leadership AMA next Wed at 11am PT to handle leftover Qs. If you can't make it, drop questions in this thread.
Marcus (Eng Manager): I'll follow up with a PR linking the perf dashboard once traces are collected.
Devon (VP Product): Thanks all 10. If anyone wants to add follow-ups, reply here and I'll slot them into the roadmap doc.
